script_text: Stop! Aquarius, the cosmos just flipped a switch and everything you thought you knew is about to shift. Saturn is conjunct Neptune at 25° Pisces, pressing firmly into your 2nd House of Income and Values, while Mars in Taurus fires a tense square to your natal Pluto sitting in the 1st House of Identity. This Air sign is being asked to rebuild from the ground up with radical honesty. Love is heating up — Venus glides into your 8th House of Intimacy, pulling you toward a deep, transformative connection that demands total emotional truth. In your career, the Saturn-Neptune conjunction in your 2nd House warns against impulsive financial moves; wait for clarity before committing to any new contract. The unexpected gift? Uranus, your ruling planet, activates a rare trine to Jupiter, showering you with a surprising opportunity this week. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
